text:
### AML/KYC Issues  
**Issue: Missed KYC Documentation**
- Handler: Compliance
- Level: 2
- Action: Obtain documentation immediately
- Timeline: Same day (before processing account)  
**Issue: PEP/Sanctions Hit**
- Handler: Compliance + Financial Crime
- Level: 3–4
- Action: Account freeze immediately
- Timeline: Within 4 hours
- Reporting: NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation)  
**Issue: Suspicious Transaction Pattern**
- Handler: Financial Crime + Compliance
- Level: 2–3
- Action: Enhanced monitoring, potential SAR
- Timeline: Investigate within 5 days
- SAR Filing: Within 30 days (if warranted)

raw_entities.name: AML/KYC Issue Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for identifying, escalating, and resolving AML/KYC compliance issues including missed documentation, PEP/sanctions hits, and suspicious transaction patterns. The process defines handler roles, escalation levels, required actions, and regulatory reporting timelines.

raw_entities.name: Missed KYC Documentation Handling
raw_entities.description: Immediate action to obtain missing KYC documentation before account processing can proceed. Assigned to Compliance handler at escalation Level 2 with same-day completion requirement.

raw_entities.name: PEP/Sanctions Hit Response
raw_entities.description: Immediate account freeze action triggered by a positive PEP or sanctions list match. Handled jointly by Compliance and Financial Crime teams at escalation Levels 3–4 with 4-hour response requirement and mandatory NCA notification.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Transaction Pattern Investigation
raw_entities.description: Investigation and enhanced monitoring of suspicious transaction patterns detected on an account. Handled jointly by Financial Crime and Compliance at escalation Levels 2–3 with 5-day investigation timeline and potential SAR filing within 30 days if warranted.

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Compliance Handler Resolution
raw_entities.description: Escalation Level 2 for AML/KYC issues including missed documentation and suspicious transaction patterns. Assigned to Compliance and Financial Crime handlers with same-day or 5-day investigation timelines respectively.

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Financial Crime Escalation
raw_entities.description: Escalation Level 3 for PEP/sanctions hits and suspicious transaction patterns requiring enhanced investigation and potential regulatory reporting. Assigned to Financial Crime and Compliance teams with 4-hour to 5-day response timelines.

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Executive Financial Crime Response
raw_entities.description: Escalation Level 4 for critical PEP/sanctions hits requiring immediate account freeze and NCA notification. Assigned to Compliance and Financial Crime teams with 4-hour response requirement.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Handler
raw_entities.description: Compliance team member responsible for handling missed KYC documentation issues, PEP/sanctions hits, and suspicious transaction pattern investigations. Acts as primary handler at Levels 2–4 with authority to freeze accounts and initiate regulatory reporting.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: Financial Crime team responsible for investigating PEP/sanctions hits and suspicious transaction patterns. Acts jointly with Compliance at Levels 2–4 with authority to recommend account freezes and SAR filings.

raw_entities.name: KYC Documentation Verification Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate verifying that all required KYC documentation has been collected and recorded before account processing proceeds. Failure triggers immediate escalation to Compliance handler with same-day remediation requirement.

raw_entities.name: PEP/Sanctions Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate screening customer identity against PEP and sanctions lists. Positive match triggers immediate account freeze, escalation to Levels 3–4, and mandatory NCA notification within 4 hours.
context: Reporting: NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Transaction Monitoring Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate for detecting and investigating suspicious transaction patterns. Positive detection triggers enhanced monitoring, investigation within 5 days, and potential SAR filing within 30 days if warranted.

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Politically Exposed Person screening check performed as part of AML/KYC compliance. Positive match requires immediate account freeze and escalation to Financial Crime and Compliance teams with 4-hour response timeline.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Sanctions list screening check performed as part of AML/KYC compliance. Positive match requires immediate account freeze, escalation to Levels 3–4, and NCA notification to the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation within 4 hours.
context: Reporting: NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation)

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Ongoing transaction monitoring to detect suspicious patterns on customer accounts. Positive detection triggers enhanced monitoring, investigation within 5 days, and potential SAR filing within 30 days.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing
raw_entities.description: Suspicious Activity Report filing obligation triggered by detection of suspicious transaction patterns. Filing must be completed within 30 days of investigation if warranted, with investigation period of 5 days.

raw_entities.name: KYC Documentation Collection
raw_entities.description: Know Your Customer documentation collection process. Failure to obtain required documentation triggers immediate escalation to Compliance handler with same-day remediation requirement before account processing can proceed.

raw_entities.name: KYC Documentation Completeness Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether all required KYC documentation has been collected. Pass path allows account processing to proceed; fail path triggers immediate escalation to Compliance handler for same-day documentation collection.

raw_entities.name: PEP/Sanctions Match Decision
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether customer identity matches PEP or sanctions lists. Positive match triggers immediate account freeze, escalation to Levels 3–4, and NCA notification within 4 hours. Negative match allows normal processing.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Transaction Pattern Detection Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether transaction patterns meet suspicious activity criteria. Positive detection triggers enhanced monitoring, 5-day investigation, and potential SAR filing within 30 days. Negative result allows normal monitoring to continue.
